version: 2026 (Chapter 131, signed 2026-05-14; applies to consequential decisions on or after 2027-01-01)

items.title: Keep records showing compliance (for example ADMT version identifiers, changelogs, mitigation changes) for at least three years after each consequential decision
Before a covered ADMT materially influences a consequential decision, give consumers clear notice, for example a prominent public notice at the point of interaction
Within thirty days of an adverse outcome, describe the decision and the role the ADMT played in plain language
Explain how to request more information: ADMT name, version, developer, and the types, categories, and sources of personal data used
Explain the consumer rights under section 6-1-1705 and how to exercise them
Tell the consumer when information is withheld as a trade secret or as legally protected
Make notices and disclosures accessible to people with disabilities and people with limited English proficiency
After an adverse outcome, on request, explain how to obtain and correct inaccurate personal data used in the decision
After an adverse outcome, on request, offer meaningful human review and reconsideration where commercially reasonable
